prerequisites.matched_graph: 254 matched positive numeric AusTraits family-trait systems, 42 families, 13 traits

separation.evidence_of_family_structure: conditional family repeatability in log(K) after named trait fixed effects
separation.evidence_of_reordering: cross-family reversal of log(K) ordering for trait pairs co-occurring in >=10 families
separation.average_trait_portability: held-out-family absolute log(K) prediction versus baseline
separation.relative_trait_portability: held-out-family within-family log(K) rank prediction versus 0.5 baseline
separation.rho_K_correlation: descriptive system-level and within-family rank correlation of log(K) with source-native rho

interpretation.condition: Report all tree axes and all inferential quantities independently without selecting the strongest axis.
interpretation.concordant: Both K tree axes have family repeatability >0.10 and well-represented trait-pair reversal >=0.40.
interpretation.partial: One but not both axes meets the concordant condition, or family/reversal criteria do not both succeed on both axes.
interpretation.discordant: Neither axis has family repeatability >0.10 nor both-axis substantial reordering; report K evidence as discordant with rho architecture.
interpretation.note: These effect-size thresholds describe correspondence with the exploratory rho architecture; K sensitivity is not an independent prospective replication and does not change the original preregistered decisions.

outcome_if_discordant: Reframe principal discovery as estimator-specific portability of distance-dissimilarity coupling. Do not claim a universal evolutionary memory hierarchy.
outcome_if_concordant: May describe architecture as detectable with two distinct phylogenetic-structure statistics while preserving different biological interpretations of rho versus Blomberg K.
inference_boundaries: K (relative to Brownian expectation) is not an evolutionary rate
rho is not a measure of the physical rate of evolutionary change
trait rankings must use same complete 254-system graph
do not claim mechanism, adaptive rewiring, or developmental reactivation
high reordering alone does not establish nonzero biological interaction without sensitivity to finite-species error
